posts.title: The Blog
posts.description: A blog by a typewriter repair tech, for typewriter people. Embracing Analog. Greetings from a dead blog to late 2026. What has happened? A lot. Will I blog about it? Not likely. I come here from time to time to cringe and reflect. Mostly to cringe. Typewriters keep me busy, and when I am not busy, I'd rather be sleeping. posts.description: This blog has been pretty dead for a rather long time, but I figured "where else am I going to talk about this stuff?"
